demonstrated.cause: product-app preferredLanding() returns Leads whenever advisorId exists before checking Dirección/Operativo/Admin roles; it does not inspect the pending notification target.
cardNegocio uses the last collaboration comment's historical sequence number, so #4 can display when only one action is currently actionable.
openNegocio awaits Orbit.cat.ensure() before constructing the modal, blocking first paint on catalog/network readiness.
UI disables buttons but gives no pending label/toast until backend update + full refresh + drawer repaint completes.

New backend writes are canonicalized to member display name, but historical comments retain role strings; UI has no human fallback/migration label and comments visually mix with business-save semantics.
Real operational businesses are intentionally immutable in Preview; a discoverable disposable human fixture is missing.

diffResumen compares raw top-level JSON and draft snapshot normalizes absent nested values to empty strings, creating false-positive changed fields; busy state starts after motive prompt/logo processing.
Productos y planes stores insurer ramos plus one plan field per ramo; products are inferred from catalog/doc sources instead of being a first-class managed offering matrix; add ramo is free-text.
docs-aseguradora is forced to documentary mode while UI is titled Importación inteligente; ramo/producto/plan are free text and file content is not extracted in this path.
Backend persists canonical insurer driveFolderId/driveLink and can read bound files, but exposes no role-authorized folder-list surface for embedding/browsing the dossier in the ficha.
Registry/source-origin identifiers are rendered directly in human UI.
UI exposes internal semantic labels 'prima contractual', 'fuente contractual' and 'calendario activo' rather than policy/receipt vocabulary.
editarInline focus only reorders fields; it does not narrow the form, so Agregar teléfono/WhatsApp opens the same full correction form.
Only the native bottom scrollbar exists on the wide table container.
Evidence suggestions are intentionally not auto-persisted; unresolved country rows remain until human confirmation or separate deterministic data apply.
Current pipeline is governed by renewability tri-state + terminal outcome, not the newly approved July-31 cutoff disposition. Old rows therefore require canonical data disposition, not UI hiding.
Scheduler is configured every 60 minutes with America/Guatemala timezone and localDate uses the same timezone; no business-hours window exists.

informationArchitecture.Productos, ramos y planes: Curated commercial offering matrix: what the insurer sells by country → ramo → product → plan, advisor-visible, source-backed but not a raw document store.
informationArchitecture.Documentos y fuentes: Evidence/source repository and insurer dossier: Drive browsing for authorized operational/admin roles, upload/classify/map each source to country/ramo/product/plan.
informationArchitecture.Tarifas y conocimiento: Derived/validated operational knowledge from classified sources: conditions, rates, rules and examples; no duplicate raw-file repository; only explicitly validated knowledge can feed Cotizador/Comparativo.
